faqs.q: What is the Gates Megashield 5000 hose assembly used for?
faqs.a: The Gates Megashield 5000 is a fire-resistant hose assembly for low-pressure offshore service, with a hydraulic-fluid-compatible synthetic rubber liner, wire braid reinforcement and a Megashield fire-resistant cover. It is rated 5,000 psi WP and crimped.

faqs.q: What inner diameters does the Megashield 5000 hose assembly come in?
faqs.a: The Megashield 5000 hose assembly is listed in inner diameters from 1/4" to 2". State the inner diameter, length and end fittings on the RFQ. Custom sizes outside the range can be quoted with a longer lead time.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the Megashield 5000 hose assembly?
faqs.a: The Megashield 5000 hose assembly is rated 5,000 psi WP. This is the working pressure, not the burst pressure, so keep the line pressure at or below it. Hydrotest pressure is normally 1.5 times WP, and the assembly ships with a test certificate.

faqs.q: What temperature range does the Megashield 5000 hose assembly cover?
faqs.a: The Megashield 5000 hose assembly is rated Fireshield rated. State the fluid temperature and the ambient range on the RFQ so the hose is confirmed for your duty.

faqs.q: What are the liner and reinforcement of the Megashield 5000 hose assembly?
faqs.a: The liner is hydraulic-fluid-compatible synthetic rubber, and the reinforcement is wire braid with a Megashield fire-resistant cover. Check the fluid compatibility of the liner against the medium before ordering.

faqs.q: What standard does the Megashield 5000 hose assembly meet?
faqs.a: The Megashield 5000 hose assembly is listed to API Spec 16D and the ISO 15540 fire test. Each assembly ships with a test certificate. State the documents you need on the RFQ; see the [oilfield hose document pack](/blog/oilfield-hose-document-pack).

faqs.q: What end fittings does the Megashield 5000 hose assembly use?
faqs.a: The Megashield 5000 hose assembly is supplied with crimped couplings. Specify the connection type, size and length on the RFQ, and the end fitting material for offshore service.

faqs.q: Where is the Megashield 5000 hose assembly used?
faqs.a: It is used for fire-resistant hydraulic lines in offshore service, such as BOP control lines. See the guide on [BOP control hose fire resistance](/blog/bop-control-hose-fire-resistance) and [well control hoses](/c/well-control-hoses).

faqs.a: The Megashield is a 5,000 psi wire-braid fire-resistant hose to 2", while the [Flameshield hose](/p/low-pressure-oilfield-hose-flameshield) is a textile-braid fire-resistant surface hose at 250-500 psi for sizes up to 6".
